cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Be There for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to show up, help, or stay involved as proof that the connection still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Come paint the old kitchen with me. Since Dad died, I barely see you. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay someone. I can't face painting over his height marks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. We'll keep them. Come help me tape around them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll probably just sit on the floor and cry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll sit with you. We can leave the paint unopened; I don't want us only meeting to empty his house.

mechanism: A confidently directs a family kitchen project but yields its tasks and pace to preserve the sibling participation that proves their bond survives.
confusable: Unlike simply providing grief support, A keeps recruiting B presence; borrowed authority turns each abandoned work requirement into A revised plan.
comparison: Shared bereavement and dropping all work differ from an opening invitation adapted around divorced parents.
seedUse: Use D73-a kitchen/height marks/crying and S02-a recasting participant conditions as leadership decisions.
